board: PulseSensor Kit / Pulse Sensor Amped by World Famous Electronics (PulseSensor.com; Adafruit #1093, SparkFun SEN-11574)
reason: Analog PPG sensor modelled as analog-sensor with a BPM-driven pulse wave centred at Vdd/2 (datasheet: 3.0-5.5 V, 4 mA, output 0.3 V..Vdd), powered from 3.3 V; check passed on ESP32 and Pico including the BPM simulator test.
breakoutPinoutSource: Manufacturer datasheet (Black=GND, Red=Vdd, Purple=Signal) and the official WorldFamousElectronics Fritzing part breadboard SVG, whose wire colours give the ribbon order black, red, purple
